desc: Derive correct formula by testing various combinations against all 3 samples
Realize the set-based greedy fails for sample 3 due to non-crossing matching constraints
Determine the answer requires patience sorting on last-occurrence indices
Implement patience sorting: compute L[i] = last occurrence of A[i], then process from right to left with a stack; for each i, pop while stack top < L[i], then push L[i]. Answer = number of pushes.
Test implementation against all 3 sample cases (expecting 3, 4, 8)
Handle edge cases and optimize for sum of N ≤ 2×10⁵
Write final solution with correct algorithm
